purpose: Source-lock-bound Track A accounting matrix. Lane dispositions preserve every retained source operation and never claim executable runtime behavior without proof.

disposition_vocabulary.implemented: Executable runtime evidence exists. Track A intentionally uses none.
disposition_vocabulary.mapped_unproven: Source-backed mapping exists but Track A makes no executable claim.
disposition_vocabulary.missing_foundation: The source-backed cell requires a named shared capability that Track A does not implement.
disposition_vocabulary.not_applicable: No retained source fact establishes this lane candidate.

mapping_policy.source_authority: Only sources/bitbucket-operation-source-lock.json supplies provider facts for this matrix.
mapping_policy.direct_read: Provider-summary bounded-read action semantics classify direct-read candidates; HTTP method and source ID are retained facts, not lane selectors.
mapping_policy.direct_write_and_reverse_etl: Provider-summary mutation action semantics classify direct-write and reverse-ETL candidates independently; HTTP method and source ID are retained facts, not lane selectors.
mapping_policy.binary: Only retained source IDs with the cited locked binary signal are candidates.
mapping_policy.etl: Only a successful response schema resolved from the retained source contract with string next and array values declares continuation; request page or cursor controls are source evidence, while schema names and HTTP method are not selectors.
mapping_policy.sync_transport: Only the four retained webhook-subscription source IDs are candidates; all remain missing_foundation pending inbound receiver capability.
